name: High School Story: Class Act
source:
Friendship, fun, and romance await you in Berry High's theatre class... if you can make it through your first day!

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/High_School_Story:_Class_Act,_Book_1]Choices Wikia[/url]]

The game succeeds [url=/v26615]High School Story[/url] and serves as a soft reboot for the series as a whole.
